claims.text: Vasospastic angina: long-acting NDHPs (diltiazem, verapamil) are first-line to prevent Sx;
claims.quote: Non-dihydropyridine, long-acting calcium channel blockers (diltiazem and verapamil) may effectively prevent symptoms and are recommended as first-line therapy (3).

claims.text: they relieve Sx but don't appear to Δ prognosis.
claims.quote: Although all these medications relieve symptoms, they do not appear to alter prognosis.

claims.text: Angina doses: amlodipine 5–10 mg (most need 10 mg);
claims.quote: The recommended dose for chronic stable or vasospastic angina is 5–10 mg, with the lower dose suggested in the elderly and in patients with hepatic insufficiency. Most patients will require 10 mg for adequate effect.

claims.text: nifedipine ER start 30 or 60 mg QD
claims.quote: Therapy for either hypertension or angina should be initiated with 30 or 60 mg once daily.

claims.text: (titration above 120 mg ⍉recommended);
claims.quote: Titration to doses above 120 mg are not recommended.

claims.text: diltiazem ER start 120 or 180 mg QD, up to 480 mg;
claims.quote: starting with a dose of 120 or 180 mg once daily. Individual patients may respond to higher doses of up to 480 mg once daily.

claims.text: verapamil 80–120 mg three times a day.
claims.quote: Clinical trials show that the usual dose is 80 mg to 120 mg three times a day.

claims.text: Also contraindicated: verapamil in severe LV dysfun
claims.quote: Severe left ventricular dysfunction

claims.text: and in AF/flutter w an accessory pathway (WPW);
claims.quote: Patients with atrial flutter or atrial fibrillation and an accessory bypass tract (e.g., Wolff-Parkinson-White, Lown-Ganong-Levine syndromes)

claims.text: NDHPs in sick sinus syndrome w.o a working pacemaker.
claims.quote: patients with sick sinus syndrome except in the presence of a functioning ventricular pacemaker

claims.text: Precaution: taper a BB (don't stop it abruptly) b4 starting nifedipine.
claims.quote: It is important to taper beta blockers if possible, rather than stopping them abruptly before beginning nifedipine.

claims.text: Counseling: swallow ER nifedipine whole; don't chew, divide or crush it.
claims.quote: PROCARDIA XL Extended Release Tablets should be swallowed whole. Do not chew, divide or crush tablets.

claims.text: Interactions: limit simvastatin to 20 mg/day w amlodipine;
claims.quote: Limit the dose of simvastatin in patients on amlodipine to 20 mg daily
claims.locator: 7.2 Impact of Amlodipine on Other Drugs

claims.text: w diltiazem, limit simvastatin to 10 mg and diltiazem to 240 mg/day.
claims.quote: If coadministration of simvastatin with diltiazem is required, limit the daily doses of simvastatin to 10 mg and diltiazem to 240 mg.

claims.text: Verapamil can raise digoxin levels 50–75% in the first wk;
claims.quote: chronic verapamil treatment can increase serum digoxin levels by 50% to 75% during the first week of therapy

claims.text: monitor digoxin levels when starting, adjusting or stopping diltiazem.
claims.quote: Monitor digoxin levels when initiating, adjusting, and discontinuing diltiazem hydrochloride therapy

claims.text: ⍉grapefruit juice w nifedipine;
claims.quote: Avoid ingestion of grapefruit and grapefruit juice should be avoided while taking nifedipine.

claims.text: it may also raise verapamil levels.
claims.quote: Grapefruit juice may increase plasma levels of verapamil.

claims.text: ⍉CYP3A4 inducers w nifedipine (eg, phenytoin)
claims.quote: Avoid co-administration of nifedipine with phenytoin or any known CYP3A4 inducer

claims.text: and diltiazem (eg, RIF).
claims.quote: Avoid coadministration of diltiazem with rifampin or any known CYP3A4 inducer.

claims.text: OD: DHPs cause marked hypotension, possibly w reflex tachy;
claims.quote: Overdosage might be expected to cause excessive peripheral vasodilation with marked hypotension and possibly a reflex tachycardia.

claims.text: NDHPs cause brady, hypotension and ♡ block.
claims.quote: Events observed following diltiazem overdose included bradycardia, hypotension, heart block, and cardiac failure.

claims.text: Tx w IV calcium, fluids and pressors;
claims.quote: judicious use of calcium infusion, pressor agents, and fluids

claims.text: atropine or pacing for brady/♡ block.
claims.quote: Bradycardia frequently responded favorably to atropine, as did heart block, although cardiac pacing was also frequently utilized to treat heart block.

claims.text: Observe a verapamil OD for ± 48 h (esp ER).
claims.quote: Treat all verapamil overdoses as serious and maintain observation for at least 48 hours (especially the extended-release formulation)
